metadata.description: A collection of Claude Code plugins by MohammadMD1383

plugins.name: usage-guard
plugins.description: Usage-limit awareness: conserve, checkpoint and hand off before claude.ai limits cut Claude off.

plugins.name: usage-bar
plugins.description: A minimal bar above the prompt: context window used/total, 5-hour and weekly limits with reset countdowns. Every section is optional.

plugins.name: progress-bar
plugins.description: A progress bar above the prompt: Claude fills it in through a tool, and any script or command reports its own through a unix socket, with a warning when a job stalls or dies.
